purpose: TEST-ONLY second-route fixture for the vNext multi-trail architecture probe. Never bundled, never loaded at runtime, never a product trail.

e8b07be Sync Delft pilot stage to the updated walkable route (0.5.1)
056817a Normalize Delft pilot GPX and generate its route data

geometryProvenance.authored: gpx.studio, drawn with the WALKING ROUTING profile (docs/delft-pilot-test.md §1.1 at commit 4ada992^)
evidence: track points carry real OSM way tags routed onto them: <highway>residential</highway>, <surface>paving_stones</surface>
the route was physically field-walked on 2026-07-07; results recorded in docs/pilot-results/delft-2026-07-07-summary.md at that commit
geometryProvenance.note: No coordinate in this file was created by the probe. The geometry follows real OSM-mapped pavements in Delft, Netherlands.

shape.elevation: present but flat (<ele>0</ele> on every track point)

probeDerivation.what: tests/helpers/secondRouteFixture.mjs derives a 4-segment / 4-waypoint GPX IN MEMORY, splitting the single stage polyline into three stages at existing track-point indices.
probeDerivation.whyNotInventedGeometry: Every lat/lon stays byte-equal to this file; the two added waypoints sit exactly on existing track points. Only the segment/waypoint framing is derived, because the historical pilot was single-stage and cannot exercise stage ordering, multi-leg days or reversal.

whyThisRoute: different bounds and aspect: near-square vs strongly north-south
different waypoints: no STF hut model behind the endpoints
different segment split: 3 derived stages vs 7 canonical stages
flat: no meaningful ascent/descent, unlike an alpine route
whyNotAProductTrail: A ~2 km urban walk is not a multi-day hike and is not a candidate for the product. It is used only as a deliberately DIFFERENT real dataset to falsify architecture claims. Fjällkompis remains a single-trail product with Kungsleden as its only visible trail.
licensing: Produced inside this project for its own field test and previously committed to this repository under the project's own terms; reused here unchanged as a test fixture. Underlying road/path geometry derives from OpenStreetMap data via gpx.studio's routing (OSM contributors, ODbL) — consistent with the attribution the app already carries for its map data.
cleanup: Delete tests/fixtures/second-route/, tests/helpers/secondRouteFixture.mjs and tests/architecture/. Nothing else references them.
